verdict.rationale: Casium is an immigration law firm with a case-tracking platform, so user-defined event-triggered automation is a fair question for it. However, the evidence describes only attorney-managed checklists, deadlines, messaging and a case dashboard, with no user-definable rules or triggers. Probes found no API or OpenAPI spec either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
